runner: Devin CLI 3000.14.30821 (a09cd7f323ee), the copy T3 Code installed, pinned for the batch. Headless `devin -p --prompt-file <prompt> --model swe-2-1-xhigh --permission-mode dangerous --respect-workspace-trust false --process-model in-process --export <file>` on t3os (Ubuntu 26.04, Ryzen 7 5700U).
reasoning_effort: xhigh (Devin picks the tier through the model id; SWE-2.1 offers low, medium, high, xhigh and max)
wrapper: sudo unshare --mount (private mount namespace, no user namespace): the run's own tmp folder bound over /tmp and an empty read-only folder over ~/.claude, ~/.agents, ~/.cursor, ~/.gemini, ~/.codex, /etc/claude-code and /etc/codex; then setpriv back to the normal user with env -i and only the run's environment. --process-model in-process, so no shared Devin daemon served the session.
isolation: Each session had its own HOME and XDG folders holding only a copy of the Devin login, a Devin config, one MCP server and a machine-only plugin whose manifest forbids every other plugin. read_config_from turned off imports from Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, Kiro, OpenCode, Zed and Devin Cloud; agents_standard stayed on so the starter's AGENTS.md and the condition's .agents/skills loaded, as in the SWE-2 Flash run. Before the runs, `devin skills list`, `rules list`, `mcp list` and `plugins list` in each condition showed only Devin's three built-in skills (devin-cli, declarative-repo-setup, upload-secrets) plus the condition's skill, the starter's AGENTS.md, the playwright server, bench-lockdown, and an account-uploaded plugin named default with no skills, agents, hooks, rules or MCP servers. Context isolation, not a filesystem jail.
preflight: Three unscored sessions at swe-2-1-medium (one per condition) listed their skills and rules files: each named only the built-in skills plus its own skill, and only the starter's AGENTS.md. A file-access trace (strace) of the no-skills preflight showed Devin opened nothing under /home/dara outside the run folder and nothing in /etc/t3os. A fourth unscored session described a canvas-only test page (blue background, yellow circle, the word KESTREL) from a Playwright screenshot alone, with no DOM or JavaScript queries, so SWE-2.1 sees its screenshots in Devin; SWE-2 Flash could not.
browser: Playwright MCP 0.0.83, --browser chromium --isolated --headless --viewport-size 1440x960 --image-responses allow, Chromium 1247 (same install as the GLM 5.4 run)
starter: Next.js 16.3.8 / React 19.2.8 starter @eeeb008, the same tarball as the GLM 5.4, GPT-6.2 Astra and Fable 5.2 runs
skill_location: work/.agents/skills/<name>, byte-identical to the GLM 5.4 run's inputs
prompt_policy: Gallery prompt with only the assigned-skill clause and the port (3511, 3512, 3513) changed; one prompt per session, no follow-ups or resumes.

sessions.context_summarized: The session reached Devin's 262K-token context limit and was summarized once, at 17:08:22 UTC. The export holds only the steps after the summary, so its tool counts leave out the first 13 minutes; Devin's saved pre-summary transcript (34 assistant turns, 50 tool results) shows the skill tool invoked as the first action.

discarded: Three preflight sessions and one screenshot check at swe-2-1-medium (unscored).

A first batch at swe-2-1-medium started 2026-11-25T16:41:56Z and was stopped at about 16:50 when Dara asked for xhigh: no-skills and frontend-design had already finished on their own (about 5 and 6 minutes); design-taste was stopped mid-run. None of it is scored; the xhigh sessions started from fresh workspaces.
timing: Concurrent sessions, not a controlled latency benchmark. Each `devin -p` exited on its own after its final reply.
cost: SWE-2.1 (swe-2-1-xhigh) is listed as Free in `devin models list` for this account, so the sessions cost nothing. Token counts come from each session's --export file (final_metrics); input includes cached input.
run_caveats: frontend-design self-hosts URW base35 fonts (P052, C059, Nimbus Narrow, URW Gothic, URW Bookman, Nimbus Mono) that it copied from the box's system font folder, with the package's copyright file (AGPL-3 with font exception).
Each session also called Devin's built-in browser_preview tool, which only opens the page for a human; it returns nothing to the model.
next-env.d.ts is regenerated by Next.js whenever a dev server starts; it is left out of the source hashes.
